name: LAGET DISCOVERY ONE PRO
why_interesting: Fully 3D-printed titanium gravel frameset with a documented 1.38 kg size-S frame, 45 mm clearance and UDH.

facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-S frame weight; included carbon fork and hardware are not stated to be part of the 1.38 kg figure
facts.frame: Fully 3D-printed titanium frame with carbon fork and UDH
facts.frame_material: 3D-printed titanium frame; exact titanium alloy grade is not published
facts.frame_construction: Fully 3D-printed unibody frame; brushed or sandblasted finish depending color
facts.stiffness_evidence: The exact-model manufacturer page publishes no stiffness value or test protocol. Retailer language describes strength qualitatively, and the manufacturer brand story's general high-stiffness claim is not model-specific; no measured or attributable exact-model stiffness result was found.

observed_price.price_basis: Exact Discovery ONE PRO brushed-finish frameset listing; no cheaper option or variant selector was present

missing: Mainland warranty issuer and invoice handling for the exact Taobao listing
Independent measured stiffness or deflection result
Exact included-package weight beyond the stated frame weight
source_note: The exact manufacturer page opened 2026-09-23 identifies DISCOVERY ONE PRO brushed silver as a 3D-printed gravel model, with a 1.38 kg size-S claim, CNY 21,900 retail and a 700×45C maximum. TiParts identifies the frame as titanium; alloy grade is unknown. Fork/hardware inclusion for the weight is unstated, and the exact Taobao listing showed CNY 21,900 on 2026-08-27 without establishing a current checkout. No model-specific stiffness result or protocol is published.

drivetrain_compatibility.note: The Chinese manufacturer page documents SRAM or Shimano mechanical or electronic 1×, maximum 44T chainring. The English page is less specific; 2× support is unconfirmed. Confirm the exact frame version before buying.

audit_corrections.reason: Add the exact-model manufacturer drivetrain restrictions; retain all previous weight, material, price, source and review observations. PRO English wording does not establish 2× support.
